title: CUE audio-check Scenario
description: Optional --scenario file for `cue audio-check <url> --scenario <path> --json`. Both fields are optional — an empty object {} runs the default probe (generic click interaction, default debug-state probe name/value).

probeState.description: Overrides the debug-state key/value used for the STATE_REACTION check (window.ANVIL_AUDIO.setState(name, value) / getDebugState()).

flow.description: Declarative interaction steps (same shape/action set as the Capture-Engine's flow format, src/core/flow.js VALID_ACTIONS) driving the CUE_FIRED check instead of the generic first-clickable-element interaction.
